notes: Profiles select assets from configs/models.manifest.json for `python videolab.py download --profile <name>`.

approx_bytes_exact_sum is the exact byte sum of the assets a profile actually downloads (repo recorded and downloadable != false), verified 2026-09-30. Rounded GB/GiB values derive from it. BYOW/manual assets are reported separately where relevant and are never included in this sum.
No profile downloads MiniMax H3 weights. h3-byow validates user-supplied copies only and requires --acknowledge-license.
Gated assets need HF_TOKEN; none of the listed download sources are gated.
`--check-sources` re-verifies every recorded repository and digest pin without downloading.

smoke.description: LTX 2.5 W4A8 core: transformer, Gemma4 text encoder, conv VAE, spatial upscaler, MSR reference LoRA, and CQ enhancer LoRA. Enough for the two-stage 1080p pipeline.

standard.description: smoke plus the Qwen-Image-2.1 quality stack with the adopted Q5_K_M quant (digest pinned to the served file; the lab never recorded a digest for this quant).

full.description: standard plus the LTX support assets (diffusion VAE, temporal upscaler, audio VAE, MSR V2) and the Qwen extras (Q4 base, turbo DiT, prompt enhancer). The downloadable size is approx_bytes_exact_sum; the MiniMax H3 entries are listed for completeness only, are never downloaded, and their bytes are reported separately as byow_bytes_exact_sum. Both previously documented-only H3 assets now carry measured on-disk sizes (int8 VAE 2.81 GB, 3D upscaler 0.69 GB) and are included in byow_bytes_exact_sum.
full.byow_note: MiniMax H3 assets are bring-your-own-weights: no profile downloads them and their bytes are excluded from approx_bytes_exact_sum. Explicit arithmetic derivation: 49,328,354,772 bytes of primary weights (ref2va 12,540,857,840 + fl2va 12,540,857,840 + text encoder 15,697,532,972 + video VAE 5,207,808,496 + audio VAE 605,254,808 + larryvrh LoRA 779,849,816 + lightx2v LoRA 1,956,193,000) plus 3,501,658,176 bytes of auxiliary assets measured on disk (int8 VAE 2,811,065,184 + 3D upscaler 690,592,992) = 52,830,012,948 bytes = 52.83 GB (49.20 GiB). H3 BYOW plus the downloadable set totals 118.30 GB / 110.17 GiB.
full.not_counted: none: both previously documented-only H3 assets now carry measured size_bytes and are included in byow_bytes_exact_sum

h3-byow.description: Bring-your-own-weights. Performs no downloads. Validates locally present H3 files against recorded sizes, and with --verify-hashes checks digests where a pin exists (the larryvrh and lightx2v LoRAs have served-file digest pins). Requires the operator to acknowledge the MiniMax H3 Community License territorial restrictions on the command line.
